rawContent: You don't get to pick and choose which survivors to believe and which to not as per your convenience #believeher #metoo

Movements change, evolve and become more inclusive. When Tarana Burke started the #metoo movement, she started it as a movement for black women. Later when more women from across the world started speaking up about their experiences, the movement expanded.

When you say #DLM is diluting #BLM, you're missing the point completely. Stop the gatekeeping. Diluting would be something like AllLivesMatter or BlueLivesMatter. But #DalitLivesMatter or #TransLivesMatter is not diluting, it is expanding the movement.
